faces.name: War Effort
faces.oracleText:
Creatures you control get +1/+0.
Whenever you attack, create a 1/1 red Warrior creature token that's tapped and attacking. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.

faces.name: War Elemental
faces.oracleText:
When this creature enters, sacrifice it unless an opponent was dealt damage this turn.
Whenever an opponent is dealt damage, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature.

faces.name: War Elephant
faces.oracleText: Trample; banding (Any creatures with banding, and up to one without, can attack in a band. Bands are blocked as a group. If any creatures with banding you control are blocking or being blocked by a creature, you divide that creature's combat damage, not its controller, among any of the creatures it's being blocked by or is blocking.)

faces.name: Warehouse Tabby
faces.oracleText:
Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token with "This token can't block."
{1}{B}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.

faces.name: Warehouse Thief
faces.oracleText: {2}, {T}, Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
